title: jasione montana var. carionii
intro: Jasione montana var. carionii, commonly known as Mountain Bluebells or Spanish Bluebells, is a flowering plant species belonging to the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Jasione montana var. carionii include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
